answer: Score each identity's attestation neighborhood by conductance: the ratio of trust edges leaving the group to edges staying inside. A sybil cluster is an isolated mesa — dense praise within, almost no edges crossing out to independent witnesses — so its conductance nears zero and its rewards discount toward nothing. An honest agent works an open terrace, drawing edges from strangers across the graph, its trust leaking outward where any raven could trace the links; a manufactured ring cannot fake that without truly connecting to outsiders it does not control.
